race.comment: ROCKY ROCKS (4) is a quality gelding who has amassed three wins and one minor placings from four starts this campaign. Kept the ball rolling last start when he finished third over 2200m at this track, beaten by a neck. Good enough to put himself in the winners' stall. AFFAMATO (3) has been competitive of late and kept the ball rolling last time when 6 metres from the winner in fourth over 2200m at this track. Sure to enjoy an economical run from this draw. Good enough to put himself in the winners' stall. DIDYALOUSAROOSTA (2) is on the radar after his last-start fifth over 2200m at this track two weeks ago. JAMES CAGNEY NZ (12) is the best of the rest after finishing sixth over 2200m at this track last time out.
